name: Sun Elf
diceAnatomy: PROVISOIRE (à confirmer user) : 1-3 = Bâton (A), 4-5 = Œil (B), 6 = Soleil (C). Pas de capture leaflet des faces.
source: Board (3 photos) + leaflet (4 captures) + 15 cartes scannées user 2026-07-07 (1 MANQUANTE : scan 221109 = doublon de Scorching Staff II). Spec : characters/Sun_Elf/SPEC.md. EN ATTENTE : faces du dé, pattern Radiant Energy base, Harness 'On BB', DAWN vs Ultimate, Sun Marked vs indéfendable.

tokens.name: Charged Gem
tokens.description: Positive Status Effect. Spend during your Main Phase and roll 1 die: 1-2 gain 1 CP; 3-4 deal 2 isolated undefendable dmg to a chosen opponent; 5-6 both.

tokens.name: Sun Marked
tokens.description: Negative Status Effect, PERSISTENT. When a player afflicted with this token is Attacked by an opponent, the Attacker Heals 2. Attack Modifier.

tokens.name: Sun Dial
tokens.description: Cadran 0-5 à deux faces, géré dans se.rules.ts (PlayerState.sunDial + sunDialDawn). Setup : 0 côté DUSK. Increase au-delà de 5 = Heal 1 par excès. DUSK : upkeep +1 ; à 5 -> flip DAWN. DAWN : si l'ORP produit une Attaque, PEUT ajouter la valeur du cadran en dmg (Attack Modifier) puis cadran -4 à la fin de la Roll Phase ; à 0 -> flip DUSK.

abilities.notes: Increase Sun Dial by 3. Heal 2. Gain Charged Gem. (Pas de dégâts.)
Inflict Sun Marked. Then deal 6 dmg. ⚠ Pattern base lu AAACC sur la photo du board, le II passe à AACC — CONFIRMATION USER REQUISE.
Deal 5 dmg and roll 1: On A add 2 dmg; On B Sun Dial +2; On C gain Charged Gem AND Sun Dial +2. II : roll 2 dice, +2 dmg PAR A, Dial +1 PAR B, sur C gem + Dial +2.
Increase Sun Dial by 1. Then deal 7 dmg.
Increase Sun Dial by 2 (II : 3). Then deal 9 dmg.
Dial +2 ; CHOIX : gagner Charged Gem OU infliger Sun Marked ; puis 8 dmg. II : gem ET mark, puis 7 dmg INDÉFENDABLES.
Increase Sun Dial by 3. Gain Charged Gem. Inflict Sun Marked. Then deal 10 dmg.

altAbilities.notes: Increase Sun Dial by 4. Inflict Sun Marked. (Pas de dégâts.)

defense.name: Harness the Light
defense.text: Defense Roll 3. Heal 1 per A. On BB (⚠ 2 Œils, une fois — à confirmer), increase Sun Dial by 1. On C (une fois), increase Sun Dial by 1. II (3 CP) : Heal 1/A ; on B Dial +1 ; Dial +1 PAR C ; on A+B+C gain Charged Gem.

cards.name: Light Staff II
cards.text: AAA: 5. AAAA: 6. AAAAA: 7. On 3-of-a-kind (#'s), increase Sun Dial by 1.

cards.name: Scorching Staff II
cards.text: ABBB: Deal 5 dmg and roll 2 dice: Add 2 x A dmg. For each B, increase Sun Dial by 1. On C, gain Charged Gem and increase Sun Dial by 2.

cards.name: Radiant Energy II
cards.text: AACC: Inflict Sun Marked on a chosen opponent. Then deal 6 dmg. Adds alt PRAISE THE SUN (AAAC): Gain Charged Gem. Deal 5 dmg.

cards.name: Solar Burst II
cards.text: CCCC: Increase Sun Dial by 2. Gain Charged Gem. Inflict Sun Marked. Then deal 7 undefendable dmg. Adds alt BESTOW YOUR LIGHT (CCC): Increase Sun Dial by 4. Inflict Sun Marked.

cards.name: Sunbeam II
cards.text: LARGE STRAIGHT: Increase Sun Dial by 3. Then deal 9 dmg. Adds alt SOAKING UP THE SUN (BCCC): Gain Charged Gem. Deal 9 dmg.

cards.name: Harness the Light II
cards.text: Defense Roll 3. Heal 1 x A. On B, increase Sun Dial by 1. For each C, increase Sun Dial by 1. On A+B+C, gain Charged Gem.

cards.name: Clouds Parting!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Roll 1 die: Increase Sun Dial by 1/2 the value rolled (rounded up).

cards.name: Solstice!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Choose one: Deal 2 dmg to all opponents OR you and all teammates Heal 2. (1v1 : 2 dmg à l'adversaire OU Heal 2.)

cards.name: Here Comes the Sun!
cards.text: Instant Action. Play only if Sun Dial is on the DUSK side. Increase Sun Dial by 2.

cards.name: It Gives Life!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Reduce Sun Dial to 0 (must reduce by at least 1). A chosen player Heals equal to the amount reduced (max 5).

cards.name: The Sun's Blessing!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Roll 1 die: On A, gain Charged Gem. On B, draw 2. On C, set Sun Dial to 5.

cards.name: Sun Shield!
cards.text: Instant Action. Remove Charged Gem to prevent 3 incoming dmg.

cards.name: First Light!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Play only if Sun Dial is at 0. Increase Sun Dial by 2. Inflict Sun Marked on a chosen opponent.

cards.name: The Glorious Sun!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Flip over your Sun Dial.

cards.name: Radiant Exchange!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. Reduce Sun Dial to 0 (must reduce by at least 1). Change the value of one of your dice to a 6.
